Definition: from G3713; a stretch of the arms, i.e. a fathom:--fathom.
BiblicalUsage: A fathom is the reach of a man's arms, the sailor's measure of depth. When Paul's ship drew near land at night, they sounded and found twenty fathoms, and a little further, fifteen.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the careful sounding of the depth is a picture of prudence in danger: they measured before they trusted the water.
